title: Food (Poly)Phenol Metabotypes and Beta-cell Mass and Function.
official: Experimental, Drug-free, Cross-sectional, Single-centre Study to Assess the Association Between Metabotypes of Dietary (Poly)Phenols and Beta-cell Mass and Function.
summary: Cross-sectional, single-centre, 'low intervention' clinical study, without drug or medical device testing, with low-risk diagnostic technique.
